finding: F2 selection record section 12.5 row 13, benign column; 05-work-agents-skills.md section 9
case: A refusal naming its predicate, accepted as a terminal state.
why: A refusal is a TERMINAL STATE of the admission record, not an error: naming its predicate and its acceptance owner is what makes it one, and demanding the owner must not prevent the refusal being recorded.
